liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (2 reviews): Jerry's guitar solo is cut in this copy; the reviewer notes the first and most noticeable edit there; Bertha was especially hot, but this version has cuts in it [16][19]
- **So Many Roads** (2 reviews): Reviewer's favorite moment: a beautiful version with a sparkling Jerry solo; Reviewer names it, along with Way To Go Home, as a highlight [21][22]
- **Drums** (1 review): An airhorn blast during drums sounds so much like a real train that the reviewer still wonders [12]
- **The Wheel** (1 other source): A Watchtower tease follows The Wheel [4]
- **Gloria** (1 review): Gloria encore follows the Lovelight, and the reviewer recommends hearing at least these last two songs [20]
- **Lovelight** (1 review): Bobby sings one of the reviewer's favorite versions, with James Cotton on harmonica, a false ending, and extra verses afterward [20]
- **Way To Go Home** (1 review): Reviewer names it, along with So Many Roads, as a highlight [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl**: back after 358 archived shows (1566 days) [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-06-25.sbd.fix-8959.tetzeli.34801.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1992-06-25.sbd.omalley.22794.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 4.11/5 by 9 [2]
- **gd92-06-25.sbd.serrafin.8959.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 3.92/5 by 25 [3]. Said about its sound: Transfer by a well-known taper/transferrer is exceptional; reviewer recommends it for showing off a top-notch playback system to audiophile friends; Reviewer calls the sound incredible; Source has an unusual perspective, unlike typical soundboards, and is meticulously mastered, letting listeners hear the music as the band does [11][12][14][16][18][19][20]
- **gd1992-06-25.dsbd.miller.32496.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 174 min; rated 3.81/5 by 16 [4]

## Around the show

- Steve Miller sat in during the second set, which the reviewer says sizzles [12]
- Reviewer stayed at grandmother's house, sold beers and sodas to drivers in rush-hour traffic, gave some to cops, and had poor seats [18]
- Hot, clear night on the lakefront with many stars visible; reviewer looked up at them during Jerry's solo [21]
- At the stadium the sound was poor from far back; reviewer moved closer, to the Phil side, a quarter of the way back on the second level [22]
- Steve Miller played guitar on some songs, and James Cotton played harp on others [2]
- Steve Miller guested on guitar for Iko Iko, Watchtower, Lovelight and Gloria; James Cotton added harp on Schoolgirl, Lovelight and Gloria [3]
- Steve Miller sat in on Iko, Schoolgirl, Watchtower, Lovelight and Gloria; James Cotton on Schoolgirl, Lovelight and Gloria [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-06-25.sbd.fix-8959.tetzeli.34801.flac16**: transferred by Fix of shnid 8959 by Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD > RF Digital Earpiece Monitor Mix Buss (mix was fed to Kreutzman/Hart) > Vault Archive ADAT > 24-bit/96 kHz 2-track Mixdown DAT (Marin County Source) > SSSB [1]. Also: Uploader fixed the seamless transition between CDs 2 and 3, verified sector boundaries with shntool, and converted shn files to flac; Drums and space were split into separate tracks; overlapping fade tracks at the CD 2/3 boundary can be removed for seamless playback [1]
- **gd1992-06-25.sbd.omalley.22794.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Jim O'Malley; source: Soundboard (was labeled Shure Beta 57's > Tascam Porta 5 DBX Analog Deck > Cass Master > DAT > CDR) [2]. Also: Originally labeled an audience source, but analysis showed it to be a soundboard [2]
- **gd92-06-25.sbd.serrafin.8959.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD > RF Digital Earpiece Monitor Mix Buss (mix was fed to Kreutzman/Hart) >Vault Archive ADAT > 24-bit/96 kHz 2-track Mixdown DAT (Marin County Source) > SSSB [3]
- **gd1992-06-25.dsbd.miller.32496.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller and Paul Scotton; source: SBD -> Dat -> CD [4]. Also: Taken from audio discs supplied by Paul Scotton, with seamless transition between discs 2 and 3 [4]
